attchmntText: Anjani Portland Cement Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Anjani Portland Cement Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 12, 2026. The standalone net loss for the half year was 34 lakhs, compared to a loss of 76 lakhs in the corresponding previous period. Standalone revenue from operations for the half year stood at 9,180 lakhs. The company reported a standalone net loss of 56 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The auditor issued a review report stating nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements. The meeting commenced at 4:30 p.m. and concluded at 5:05 p.m.
